correctness.rationale: Over algebraically closed char5, F_t=X⁶+Y⁶+Z⁶+t(X³Y³+Y³Z³+Z³X³). Its derivative system has eigenvalues 2−t (twice) and 2+2t on the three-nonzero coordinate stratum, and 4−t² on the two-nonzero stratum, giving smoothness iff t∉{2,3,4}. Smooth plane sextics have genus10. The standard Čech Hasse–Witt entry [X^{5α−β}]F_t⁴ for 10 positive triples α,β summing to6 expands to exactly 12 nonzero polynomial entries: three invertible transposition pairs coefficient A=−t(t−2)²(t+2), and a 4-coordinate block with three B=2t(t+2) entries and three D=2t(t−2)³. At smooth t≠0 the matrix has an invariant 8-dimensional Frobenius-stable invertible summand and 2-dimensional killed summand. All twists of nonzero coefficients remain nonzero, so semilinear Frobenius stable rank equals eight, not just one-step rank; a-number=2. At t=0 all vanish and a=10, p-rank0. Independently reconstructed F_t⁴ multinomial coefficients and all 100 Hasse–Witt matrix entries, checked exactly 12 nonzero and rank 0/8 at F5 parameters. Finite check corroborates symbolic result, not higher field extrapolation.
residual_risks: All conclusions require characteristic exactly five and smooth fibers; excludes t=2,3,4.
No Newton polygon, Ekedahl–Oort type, or full zeta-function classification is asserted.

value.rationale: The 5-rank and a-number are core arithmetic-geometric invariants of Jacobians. The complete uniform stratification of a natural genus-ten family distinguishes a superspecial Fermat point from a large smooth p-rank-eight locus, and explicitly resolves the stable-Frobenius issue rather than confusing one-step rank with p-rank.
residual_risks: Value concerns the precise scoped invariant; it is not evidence of additional unstated stronger implications.

scientific_limitations: Only smooth members of coefficient-marked family in char5, not singular normalizations, Newton polygons or all genus-ten sextics.
